mapper.sql: select task_id, user_id, provider_code, prompt, model, quality, ratio, size, resolution, image_urls, image_count, status, progress, result_image_url, preview_image_url, error_message, credit_cost, run_start_time, finish_time, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from ai_generation_task
mapper.select: where task_id = #{taskId} and user_id = #{userId} and status != 'deleted'
mapper.update: update ai_generation_task set status = 'deleted', progress = 100, error_message = '用户删除', finish_time = coalesce(finish_time, sysdate()), update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 'success'
